verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships generative AI features (Comply AI for policies, risk, and vendor reviews), so asking whether customer data is excluded from model training is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use controls for AI. The AI-feature and MCP citations describe AI capabilities, not training-data protections, so they earn no credit.
